In prior code buildings, LULA elevators shall comply with Section 408 (Limited-use/Limited-Application Elevators) of ICC A117.1 and with Part 5.2 of ASME A17.1 as modified by Appendix K of this code. LULA elevators shall be limited to a maximum rise of not more than 25 feet (7620 mm) and shall be permitted to be a part of the required accessible route as follows:
   1.   In spaces complying with Section 1109.7.1 of this code where a LULA is permitted in new construction;
   2.   Where the total floor area of the entire building is less than 10,000 square feet (929 m 2 ); or
   3.   Where it serves an individual occupancy of less than 10,000 square feet (929 m 2 ) in buildings of 10,000 square feet (929 m 2 ) or more.
